title: Multi-window shared-state memory with dynamic groundwater

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: Do not implement DUMMY-11 before DUMMY-10 qualification is recorded.

purpose: Propagate the DUMMY-10 coupled surface and groundwater heads through multiple windows and compare discrete partition behavior with an independent continuous two-store event reference.

event_rule.trigger: first t in [0,T] where h_s(t)=hmin under full demand
event_rule.post_event: set management rate to zero; total two-store storage remains constant and d decays exponentially with rate kappa
event_rule.solution_method: independent monotone bracketed root solve of analytic h_s(t)-hmin; no reuse of discrete DUMMY-10 solver

contrast_fixed_groundwater_DUMMY_08.interpretation: finite groundwater storage delays management shutoff by reducing the exchange gradient as groundwater head rises

experiments.M1: multi-window accepted state propagates both h_s and h_g, with each window starting exactly from the previous accepted pair
experiments.M2: combined two-store storage loss over every window and over the full run equals cumulative managed delivery; internal exchange cancels exactly
experiments.M3: in nonbinding FULL-demand cases, discrete equal-step propagation matches the independently derived trapezoidal recurrence for mean and difference modes
experiments.M4: canonical continuous event reference matches the preregistered event time, final heads, cumulative delivery and cumulative exchange
experiments.M5: uniform discrete refinement approaches the continuous two-store event reference overall while retaining possible event-grid jitter near active-set switching
experiments.M6: finite groundwater storage yields later management shutoff and greater cumulative delivery than the otherwise matched fixed-groundwater DUMMY-08 reference
experiments.M7: after management reaches ZERO, reciprocal physical exchange continues to update both heads and can move surface head below hmin
experiments.M8: no shortage backlog is carried; per-window request remains request_rate*dt regardless of prior shortage
experiments.M9: as A_g increases, multi-window behavior approaches the fixed-groundwater DUMMY-08 family over the same horizon

interpretation_rules: groundwater memory is represented only by the finite linear storage state qualified in DUMMY-09/DUMMY-10
temporal partition error and conservation are assessed separately
the continuous event reference is independent of the discrete active-set implementation
no real MODFLOW storage mapping is inferred
forbidden: no DUMMY-11 implementation before DUMMY-10 qualification
no shortage carryover or adaptive SWAP demand
no claim that the linear two-store continuous reference represents a real MODFLOW aquifer
